newsitem.title: USA: CBOT November soybeans down 30-cent/bushel limit.
newsitem.headline: CBOT November soybeans down 30-cent/bushel limit.

text.p: CBOT November soybean futures fell the 30-cent-per-bushel daily limit on Monday after the U.S. Agriculture Department projected U.S. farmers planted 70.85 million acres of soybeans this year, traders said.
December soymeal also touched the $10 per ton lower limit, following losses in soybeans.
USDA's acreage forecast came in above average trade expectations for 68.4 million acres and would make this year's planted area the largest in 15 years, since 1982.
At 1002 CDT, soybeans were down 30 to 13 cents per bushel with November offered down 30 at $6.17-1/2. Soymeal was off $10.00 to $4.70 per ton with December offered $10.00 lower at $200.60.
